requirements.name: Exact Long-Term Market Structure horizon
requirements.rule: Long structure requires canonical weekly evidence; insufficient weekly history is UNAVAILABLE; no daily substitution.

requirements.name: Historical context freshness truth
requirements.rule: Market Structure and Relative Strength reject stale/future bars; UpdatedAt is evidence-derived.

requirements.name: Liquidity spread evidence truth
requirements.rule: Missing/invalid/crossed bid-ask remains UNKNOWN; current last trade alone is never NORMAL/LOW RISK.
